name: chandra_heart_of_fire_plus_one_plays_the_exiled_cards_paying_their_costs
notes: Printed: 'Until end of turn, you may PLAY cards exiled this way.' The +1 exiles Shock, Mountain and Goblin Arsonist. The Mountain is played from exile (the turn's land play, CR 305.2a) and tapped to cast Goblin Arsonist from exile for its {R} (CR 601.3): a red spell cast from elsewhere, which Quirion Dryad sees (+1/+1 counter). With no mana left Shock is not castable: the permission waives no cost, so the menu offers nothing and the last word is never asked.
